shared_contract.RAQM: Pass original Unicode codepoints via raqm_set_text(UCS4); default paragraph direction; no explicit features/language; raqm_set_freetype_face then raqm_layout/get_glyphs. Keep returned visual glyph order,index,x/yoffset,x/yadvance and clusters; do not manually reverse or decode oneglyphperrune. shared_contract.RAQM_load_flags_chain: Pillow does NOT call raqm_set_freetype_load_flags. VendoredRaqm percharacterftloadflags=-1; hb_ft_font_create_referenced receives no override. PinnedHB14.2.1 default FT_LOAD_DEFAULT|FT_LOAD_NO_HINTING. Thus shape/advance metrics are unhinted even though final rasterization is hinted. Do not set Raqm flagsDEFAULT as an apparent simplification.
shared_contract.BASIC: Unicodecodepoints -> FT_Get_Char_Index -> FT_Load_Glyph(DEFAULT); zero offsets; xadvance=glyph.metrics.horiAdvance26.6, yadvance0. FT_HAS_KERNING with previous nonzeroindex triggers FT_Get_Kerning(DEFAULT). Actualsource quirk adds PIXEL(delta) directly to26.6 advance; do not multiply back by64. Proven syntheticDejaVuBASIC To advance895/64 vs separate14.0. AileronTTF has GPOS but no kern table; tablepresence alone is not runtimekerning flag proof.
shared_contract.render_flags: Actual modeL/stroke0/embeddedcolorfalse -> FT_LOAD_DEFAULT (targetNORMAL) for bbox and DEFAULT|RENDER for two bitmap passes. No MONO, NO_BITMAP, LCD, FT_Set_Transform, artificial DPI or color flag requested. Both fixed fonts contain outlineglyf, not embeddedbitmap tables; arbitrarycolor/variable/fontfallbackformats are not required by these callers.
shared_contract.bbox: Startbounds at0, include penline advance as well as ink. For each glyph use PIXEL(pen+offset), loadDEFAULT, FT_Get_Glyph/CBox(PIXELS), union. Default anchor la: xanchor0,yanchor=PIXEL(ascender); width=xmax-xmin,height=ymax-ymin; return bearing(xmin,ascender-ymax). Do not replace with positive-ink bbox or top-left baseline assumption.
shared_contract.rounding: PIXEL(v)=((v+32)&-64)>>6: integer26.6 nearest with ties towardpositiveinfinity, including negativecoordinates. Not RoundToEven/round-away. ImageDraw splits coordinate with int(towardzero), math.modf(signedfraction); getmask2 passes start throughCfloat(ff). Width/height addceil(start) for stroke0; origin usesCround(floatarithmetic*64) then PIXEL. Cround tiesaway fromzero differs fromPIXEL. Actual caller anchors areintegers, but fractionalRAQM penpositions remain material.
shared_contract.mask_raster: Allocate zeroL mask. First rendered pass finds bitmapleft/top extrema at roundedglyphpositions. Setorigin fromextrema+start; secondpass usesDEFAULT|RENDER and bitmapleft/top, signedpitch and glyphadvances. Per-glyph graycoverage overlaps use alphaover: src + round255(dst*(255-src)), saturated; not max, sum or bitwiseOR. ModeMONO/GRAY2/GRAY4 conversion exists in primarysource but fixedoutlinefontNORMAL output isgray8.
shared_contract.final_paste: Original ImageDraw mask bearing added to integer anchor; constantforeground RGB is blended with glyphcoverage againstexistingopaqueRGB viaDIV255. No global layerpremultiplication or second opacity multiplication. ExistingpixelOver matches opaqueRGBresult as prior262144-channelvectorproof; rawRGBApastegeneralization is not implied.
shared_contract.empty_whitespace: Emptytext mask0x0/bearing0,0/advance0 is valid. DejaVuspace mask4x0/bearing0,11/advance224/64; Aileronspace2x0/bearing0,10/advance128/64. Blankmask can have nonzeroadvance; no falsemalformed glyph error.
shared_contract.multiline: ImageDraw defaults splitnewline (includingemptyline), alignleft, anchorla, spacing4. Line step=font.getbbox(A).bottom+4 (15 forDejaVu11,14 forAileron10), NOT ascent+descent+4. Default noauto-wrap/truncate. Six wholelabelvectors pin multiple and blank lines.
